_README: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json is gitignored - your shop's numbers never enter this repo. Keys beginning with _ are comments and are ignored.

shop.name: Your Shop Name
shop._timeZone: An IANA zone. The UTC offset is derived from this so daylight saving cannot silently shift your week.
shop._serviceBays: Informational only - you type this into the form yourself. It changes more often than you expect.

sms._provider: tekmetric is the ONLY reader that ships. Any other value stops the script with an explanation - there is no built-in manual mode for the sales side. For another management system, ask Claude to write a reader that returns the same shape; nothing downstream cares where the repair orders came from.

tekmetric._shopId: Your numeric Tekmetric shop id. It appears in the shop.tekmetric.com URL: /admin/shop/<shopId>/...
tekmetric._envPath: Path to a file holding TEKMETRIC_CLIENT_ID and TEKMETRIC_CLIENT_SECRET. Keep it OUTSIDE this repo. Relative paths resolve from the repo root.

carCount._excludeServiceWriterIds: Employee ids whose ROs are not customer cars - your 'Internal RO' and 'Employee Vehicles' pseudo-writers. MATCH ON ID, NEVER ON NAME: display names get renamed, ids do not. Find them by listing your employees in the API or by checking an internal RO. NOTE: the owner's own ROs DO count as cars - only their wages are excluded.

inspection._jobNamePattern: Case-insensitive regex matching your canned inspection job. Counted as distinct ROs carrying a COMPLETED one, not as a count of jobs.

supplies._feeNamePattern: Case-insensitive regex for fees that count as Supplies/Hazmat Sales. Deliberately narrow - it must NOT sweep in card processing, tips, roadside, rentals or protection plans.

cost._mode: flat | report. 'flat' enters flatAmount. 'report' is NOT implemented on purpose - see FIELD-MAP.md. Your SMS report's Supplies Cost is a fixed percentage of supplies sales, which is a suggested markup, not a measured expense.

discounts._mode: netted | bundled. ASK YOUR COACH WHICH YOU WERE TAUGHT. 'netted' files CPTS Discounts as $0.00 and subtracts each discount from the sales line it came off. 'bundled' puts the whole total in the Discounts field and enters sales gross. Both are legitimate.
discounts._offLaborPattern: Case-insensitive regex. A discount whose NAME matches this goes entirely to Labor. Covers 'New Client - 10% Off Labor', 'Senior Discount - 15% Off Labor' and so on. Adjust to match how your advisors name discounts.

tires._partTypeCode: The part type your SMS assigns to tires. Rims are usually typed PART and stay in Mechanical Parts Sales.
tires._protectionPlanPattern: Fee name for the tire protection plan. Counted PER TIRE on the job, not per fee line.
tires._alignmentPattern: Matched against SUBLET names, authorized only. Alignments usually come through as sublets, not jobs.
tires._tpmsPattern: Match TPMS explicitly. NEVER match the bare word 'sensor' - it hits things like a DPF Differential Pressure Sensor and invents a tire sale.

manual._README: Read these four off your payroll report and put them here each week, or leave them null and the script will just print a dash for you to fill in by hand.

notion._README: An internal integration token and two data source ids. A 404 here almost always means wrong token, wrong API version, or /databases/ instead of /data_sources/ - not missing permission.
notion._payPeriodFormat: How your Pay Period select values are labelled. {mon} and {sun} are the Monday and Sunday of the period, {yy} the 2-digit year. Notion pay periods often run Mon-Sun while ATI weeks run Sun-Sat; this maps between them.
notion._serviceWriterNames: First names of the service advisors whose wages belong in SMgr./Writer Wages.
notion._alwaysExcludePattern: Case-insensitive regex of names NEVER counted in wages - the owner, and office or admin staff. ATI counts owner pay as a fixed expense, so including it double-counts.

quickbooks._README: Not implemented. See scripts/lib/payroll-quickbooks.js - the shape is laid out. If you run QuickBooks or QBO Time for payroll, ask Claude to finish it against your account.
